paragraphs.text: Obsidian vault table of contents as a conversation view — folders, tags, word counts, headings, and
one-click @-path copying.
# Obsidian Catalog · 知识库目录
A DeepSeek Harness bundle that renders an Obsidian vault as a live table of contents inside a conver
arness bundle that renders an Obsidian vault as a live table of contents inside a conversation view.
The panel reads the vault directory straight off disk on the host side and shows it grouped by folde
r: note titles, word counts, relative dates, tags, and a collapsible outline of each note's headings
. Every note row and folder row has a one-click `@absolute\path` copy button, so the note can be ref
erenced in the chat box without typing the path by hand. The vault itself is chosen from inside the
panel, so a second vault does not need a second install.
## What it does
- **Live folder tree** — groups follow the vault's directory structure, with a note count per group.
Each group and each note collapses independently; two header buttons collapse or expand everything

at once.
- **Search** — filters across title, full path, tags and heading text. Search temporarily e

xpands every match.
- **Per-note stats** — CJK-character plus Latin-word count, relative modificatio

n date, and frontmatter tags read from the vault.
- **Heading outline** — the first three heading le
vels of each note, indented by level, with the leading `#` stripped. A heading identical to the note

title is skipped.
- **`@` path copying** — `复制 @ 路径` on a note row copies `@D:\Notes\MyVault\folder
\note.md`; `@ 引用文件夹` on a folder row copies `@D:\Notes\MyVault\folder` (the vault root copies `@D:\N

otes\MyVault`). Both flash a confirmation in place.
- **Vault switching** — `选择仓库` opens a directory
browser: paste a path and press `Go`, walk up with `.. 上级`, or pick a drive. Directories that look
like a vault (contain a `.obsidian` folder) are marked; `使用此目录` switches the panel to that vault and

remembers the choice.
- **Refresh** — rescans on demand, and polls every 15 seconds. Unchanged note
s are served from a `mtime + size` cache.

Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x.
## Configuration
The vault is resolved in this order:

1. `~/.dsh/obsidian-catalog.json` — written by `使用此目录`, shaped `{ "vault": "D:\\Notes\\MyVault" }`
2

. the `DSH_OBSIDIAN_VAULT` environment variable
3. `<home>\obsidian` as a fallback
Deleting the config file returns the panel to the fallback.
## HTTP routes
The bundle registers three routes on the host `webServer` service. All are read-only except the vaul
t switch, and all are scoped to markdown files inside the selected vault.
| Method and path | Purpose |
| `GET /api/obsidian-catalog` | Snapshot of the selected vault: notes, tags, headings, word counts |
| `GET /api/obsidian-catalog/dirs?path=` | Directory browsing: an empty `path` lists drives, otherw

ise subdirectories plus whether each one is a vault |
| `POST /api/obsidian-catalog/vault` | `{ "pat
h": "D:\\Notes\\MyVault" }` — validates the directory, scans it, then persists the choice |
## Layout
| File | Purpose |

| `index.js` | Host side: registers the three routes, scans the vault, caches by `mtime + size` |
|
`client.js` | Client side: `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)`, registers the `obsidian-catalog` vie

w on `conversation.view` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | `- insert: [{ id: obsidian-catalog, name: dsh-plug

in-obsidian-catalog }]` |
| `locale/*.json` | Chinese and English title and description |
| `screens
hots.json` | Storefront screenshots, relative to this file |
The panel uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so it follows the active light or dark theme.
## Notes
- The panel is read-only with respect to the vault: it stats and reads files, and never writes to th

em.
- Word counts use the same rule as the companion Obsidian plugin: CJK characters plus Latin word

s (`[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9'’\-]*`).
- Scan limits: at most 12 directory levels and 5000 markdown files p

er scan.
- Every screenshot on this page was rendered from a synthetic six-note demo vault; no real
notes, paths or account names appear in them.
